name: 01e-tunable-refused
note: Refused by name. Credentials, provider endpoints, retention ceilings and deployment controls are server-owned; so is an unknown field. A tunable that was accepted and then ignored is the defect this replaced — the client would have been told its request succeeded while collection ran on other settings.

body.detail: staying: not settable per session — provider endpoints, credentials, rate limits and retention ceilings are server-owned.
